name: CE_CP_USER_ACCESS_INT
description: This interface table contains the user name with access to bank account.

columns.name: USER_INTERFACE_ID
columns.description: Sequentially generated surrogate key for user access interface table.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the user with access to the bank account.

columns.name: BANK_NAME
columns.description: Name assigned to a bank for identification purposes.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Name assigned to a bank account for identification purposes.

columns.name: DELETE_FLAG
columns.description: Represents a deleted transaction from the source. Valid values are Yes or No.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
